comment: Generated by proto/go/zs TestPersistedCatalogVectors. The saved operator catalog, format_version 1. catalogs: bytes is exactly what Go writes for operators, and what TS must write too; loaded is what reading bytes back yields (proto_version floored to minor 0, and nothing a probe sets). loads: files only Go writes or that neither writes, read to loaded. rejects: files both refuse. Operators use neutral snake_case names; times are Unix ms, 0 for none; the signing key is hex, empty for none.

catalogs.name: a node with every persisted field set
text and map keys Go escapes and orders
floats at the format boundaries, and nodes kept in order

loads.name: a time in a local zone with nanoseconds, and a node version
an unknown key and absent fields
a retention tier this build does not know is dropped on load, a known one kept
nulls where Go leaves the zero value
zone offsets at Go's outer bounds, hour 24 and minute 60

rejects.name: operators that are not a list
a string where a version belongs
a string where an id belongs
a list where a model list belongs
a number in a model list
a string where a flag belongs
a time that is not RFC 3339
a time on a day that does not exist
a signing key that is not base64
metrics that are not an object
